remarks: Welcome to this charming and well-maintained three-bedroom, 1.5-bath home, beautifully situated on nearly two acres in a private and scenic setting. With vacant lots on both sides—each approximately 0.65 acres—this property offers an exceptional sense of space and privacy. A covered front porch with a swing welcomes you and provides the perfect spot to relax and enjoy the peaceful natural surroundings. Inside, the foyer opens to a spacious living room featuring a picture window and a formal dining room, with hardwood flooring underneath. The eat-in kitchen is equipped with a stove, refrigerator, range hood, and dishwasher. Just off the kitchen, the inviting family room features laminate flooring, a cozy gas fireplace, and sliding glass doors leading to a deck overlooking the wooded grounds—an ideal space for entertaining or enjoying quiet evenings outdoors. The primary bedroom offers a full wall of closets, while the full bathroom includes a tiled tub surround. A full basement provides abundant storage and additional utility space, complete with glass-block windows and a washer and dryer. Additional features include a double-wide driveway, brick and vinyl exterior, storage shed, pull-down attic stairs, and beautiful natural woodwork throughout. Located near the West River bike path and Beaver Island State Park, this property offers a wonderful combination of privacy, nature, and convenience. Selling to settle an estate.
